lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 002: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: US-001 AC4's oracle text (`grep -q 'self-nullifying-oracle' scripts/cam/handoff.json`) still lives, unmodified, inside scripts/cam/prd.json's acceptanceCriteria, per the same structural-unfixability note US-R1-001 recorded (Write/Edit/MultiEdit on scripts/cam/prd.json is hard-blocked for CAM_WORKER=1 sessions by .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh). Unaffected by this story; carried forward unchanged since neither this story's scope nor an implementer's tool access permits fixing it.
nextStoryContext: US-R1-002 (CAM-376 review round 1, WARNING severity) fixed the vacuous-empty-array gap at test/dispatch.test.ts:769 that US-R1-001's sibling finding described: the strengthened idle-gate backoff assertion `recordedSleeps.every((ms) => ms === POLL_INTERVAL_MS)).toBe(true)` was true even for an empty array, so a regression that stopped the idle-gate from sleeping at all (or returned before its poll loop) would have passed silently, contrary to the in-test comment's own derivation of 'exactly 5 sleeps' from idleTimeoutMs/pollIntervalMs. Fix: added a named `IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000` const alongside the existing `POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 1_000`, wired IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS into the `idleTimeoutMs` override (previously a bare 5_000 literal), and added `expect(recordedSleeps).toHaveLength(IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS / POLL_INTERVAL_MS)` immediately before the existing `.every(...)` assertion, so the count and the per-element shape are both independently falsifiable and the comparand is derived from the same override constants rather than a frozen literal (derive-don't-freeze rule, patterns.md). test/dispatch.test.ts grew 838->847 lines, which tripped the file-size ceiling gate; raised only that file's ceiling in scripts/file-size-budget.json to 847 (the gate's own `content.split('\n').length` count, one more than `wc -l`'s 846 for this trailing-newline file) with a dated _ref note naming this story and CAM-376, staged before re-running check:all. Documented the general antipattern (Array#every/#some on a collection whose non-emptiness needs its own assertion is vacuous when empty) as a new bullet in scripts/cam/patterns.md, cross-referenced against the empty-$L-anchor shell-oracle antipattern at patterns.md:901 (US-R1-001's bullet) as the in-test-assertion analogue of the same failure family. Full quality spine (typecheck, bun test — 5192 pass/0 fail, check:all including coverage/dead-code/dup/lint/file-size/agents-md/ci-parity/test-sleeps) is green post-fix. No production code (src/) was touched; test-only + budget-metadata + patterns.md diff.
